gate: R20 gate 2 (H-C) - share of H157 FP rank-loss mass traceable to operand/role/sign/period misbinding
recipe_summary: classify every H157 false-positive record by its own `unsupported_explanation` into misbind_{operand,role,sign,period} vs wrong_computation vs question_relativity vs other; mass = per-item rank loss averaged over the two draws

31.reason: trend stated as a decrease; equity increased

36.reason: correct arithmetic applied to the wrong year (2012 vs 2011)

41.reason: the cited figures are absent from the documents

43.reason: 'in thousands' notation misread - scale, not role/sign/period

67.reason: the figure is correct; the question asked for a portion

85.reason: asserts data absent that the documents carry

114.reason: the $74.9M repurchase amount used as the decrease in notes

116.reason: an extrapolated prediction, unsupported by construction

157.reason: the sum is formed from the wrong operands

168.reason: a computed decrease reframed as an increase

200.reason: $5.2bn vs the documents' $5bn, plus an invalid combination

215.reason: assumes an improvement the documents contradict

229.reason: values bound to 2009; the documents carry only earlier years

threshold: PASS if >= 0.30 of FP rank-loss mass is operand/role/sign/period misbinding (primary denominator = the classified FP records' mass; the all-negatives denominator is carried as the strict reading)

edgar_census.threshold: PASS if >= 20,000 sentences carry value + role word + period
